style.styleTitle: Homcom Lighted Musical Tabletop Gingerbread House
style.toneOfVoice: Capture the holiday spirit with this hand-painted gingerbread house decoration, finished with snow details. Illuminated by warm white LEDs, it features an animated train rotating around the base and plays 8 classic Christmas melodies. The switch allows you to choose between lights with music or lights only. Powered by batteries for cordless placement, it includes a non-slip base to protect tabletop surfaces while bringing nostalgic festive cheer to your mantel or entryway. Hand-painted polyresin gingerbread house with snow-covered detail brings festive charm to tables and mantels. Warm white LEDs deliver a cosy, inviting ambient glow. Built-in animated train continuously rotates around the base to add dynamic movement and nostalgic charm. Plays 8 classic Christmas melodies to fill your living space with rich holiday harmony. Convenient 3-position switch allows you to choose between lights with music, lights only, or fully off. Cordless design powered by 3 AA batteries (not included) allows flexible placement anywhere in your home. Bottom base features non-slip plastic feet to protect table surfaces, mantels, and shelves from scratches. Crafted from selected polyresin with detailed hand-painted finishes for seasonal display. Ready to display straight out of the box to instantly elevate indoor Christmas decor. Colour: Brown. Light Colour: Warm White. Material: Polyresin. Overall Dimensions: 17W x 17D x 22.5H cm. Light Count: 7 LED Lights. Music Feature: 8 Christmas Melodies. Power Output: 0.68 W. Voltage: 3 V (Per LED). Power Supply: Battery Operated (3 x AA Batteries, not included). Custom Label: 83C-268V00BN. Dimensions(mm): Height: 225, Width: 170, Depth: 170.
